title: Things related to Samba are listed without a name under Places > History > Folders
line: Kickoff's History now shows a name for Samba locations like the network root or a server, instead of a blank entry.
explanation: Kickoff's History labels a recent folder with its Places name or, failing that, its file name. URLs like smb:/ or smb://server/ have no file name, so those entries showed only an icon. The change falls back to the host name, or to the URL itself, the same texts Dolphin uses for its tab titles.

commits.message:
kicker: Show a name for recent folders without a file name

Kickoff's History listed folders like smb:/ or smb://server/ without a
label, because their URL has no file name to show. Fall back to the
host name, or to the URL itself, as Dolphin does for its tab titles.

BUG: 516894

media.caption: Folders: smb:/ and smb://server/ show as two entries with no label
The same entries now read "smb:/" and "server"
